rows.partiesBlurb: Customers, suppliers, and the ones who are both — with their running balance.

today.suspendedBody: ResiSmart has paused this account. Contact support to have it looked at.
today.notFoundBody: {{reasons}} Until this is sorted out, nobody can book or order from you.
today.notFoundBodyNoReasons: Your business is not appearing in Services & shops yet.
today.awaitingRoleBody: You are on this business’s staff list, but nobody has said yet what you may do. Ask the owner to set your role.
today.checkingDocsTitle: You are live — we are still checking your documents
today.checkingDocsBody: {{message}} There is nothing for you to do; we will let you know as soon as it is done.
today.pendingOrdersBody: Waiting on you to accept or turn down.
today.nothingOnBody: Turn on Bookings, Orders or Catalogue from Settings to see them here.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: What residents said, and your reply
reviews.noBusinessContext: Reviews belong to one business, and this session is not in a business context.
reviews.loadFailed: We could not load your reviews.
reviews.emptyBody: Residents can review you once a booking or an order is closed.
reviews.replyFailed: That reply could not be posted.

reply.windowClosed: This reply has been public for over 24 hours and can no longer be edited.
reply.placeholder: Answer this customer. Everyone reading your profile will see it.

live.title: Available for an immediate job right now
live.hint: A live switch, separate from the weekly hours below. Turn it on when you can head out on a job straight away — residents looking for someone right now see you first. It does not change your schedule, and stays on until you turn it off.
live.on: You are marked available for an immediate job.
live.off: You are no longer marked available right now.
live.failed: Could not update your live availability

screen.intro: When residents can book you. Pick a week below, adjust anything that is not right, and save — this is what decides the times they are offered.
screen.readOnly: View only — your role does not include managing bookings.
screen.loadFailed: We could not load your working hours.
screen.allClosed: Nothing is bookable while every day is closed
screen.blackoutHint: Festivals, holidays, a day off. Nothing can be booked on these, whatever the week above says.
screen.cutoffHint: The notice does two jobs: nothing can be booked inside it, and a customer who cancels inside it loses the advance.
screen.timezoneHint: Every hour above is read in this zone — including on a phone set to a different one.
screen.takingOnHint: Switch this off to stop new bookings without losing the hours you have set.
screen.takingOffHint: No new bookings are being taken. Everything you have set up is kept.

problem.allClosed: Every day is closed, so nobody can book anything. Open at least one day, or switch off "Taking bookings" below if that is what you meant.
problem.noHours: You have not said what hours you are open on {{day}}.
problem.notATime: Those opening hours on {{day}} are not a time.
problem.closeBeforeOpen: On {{day}} you close before you open. A window like that produces no slots at all.
problem.overlap: Your opening hours on {{day}} overlap each other.
problem.slotTooLong: On {{day}} a slot is longer than the time you are open, so there is nothing to book.
problem.breakBackwards: That break on {{day}} ends before it starts, which blocks nothing while looking like a lunch hour.
